## What is Wokyintosh?

Wokyintosh is a free, open-source macOS dashboard inspired by the classic Macintosh.

It is designed especially for small secondary displays and retro dock setups, showing a large clock and date, local weather, Apple Music and Spotify Now Playing with artwork, plus live CPU, RAM, SSD and network statistics. It also automatically follows the macOS light and dark appearance.
